bio.text: Kasie Whitener is the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in South Carolina in 2026, according to the SC Daily Gazette's voter guide.
According to the voter guide, Whitener lives in Blythewood and co-hosts "Mornings with Kasie and Kev" on 100.7 The Point, a Columbia talk radio station.
The guide also says Whitener hosts a podcast, "Moore Impact," at the University of South Carolina business school, where Whitener teaches entrepreneurship, and owns Clemson Road Creative.
